notes:
The flat JSON did not exist yet (only 1-Bricky, 2-Fuzzbop, 3-Wobble were there), so I generated it with the pipeline's own scratchpad/flatten.cjs into scratchpad/flat/5-Bubblegoo.json and used that for the indices. 34 shapes, 0..33, each assigned exactly once. I rendered the split (original / part-coded / each part alone) to check it by eye, not just by coordinates.

NO DOUBLE-DRAWN SILHOUETTE in this one. Shape 9 is a single filled+stroked path; the belly 17 is fill-only with stroke="none"; nothing is a stroke-only copy of an earlier filled path. The only fill="none" shape is 25, and that is the eyebrow, not a duplicate outline.

ONE EYE. This is a cyclops: eyeball 20 (white, navy stroke, r=74 at 242,322), iris 21, pupil 22, two catchlights 23 and 24 (both verified to fall inside the iris), and a single brow arc 25 that sweeps over the whole eye (fill none, stroke sw=7). There is no second eye to mirror.

ARMS ARE POSED DIFFERENTLY, not mirrored. Arm 4 sits screen-left, attaches high on the body (y≈274..296) and reaches up and out to a 4-bump hand at x 27..100, y 158..200 — box x 27..134, y 158..296. Arm 5 sits screen-right, attaches lower (y≈325..335) and is distinctly shorter and stubbier — box x 408..487, y 213..335. Different lengths, different attachment heights, different hands.

FOUR LEGS, not two — tapered tentacles 0,1,2,3, so the usual "one leg mirrored" assumption does not hold. They form two rough pairs: outer 0/3 is approximately mirrored about x≈232 and inner 1/2 about x≈241, but the right-hand copies drift up to ~16 units off a true mirror and the y values differ by 2, so all four are separately drawn paths. Midpoint x: 115, 200, 289, 363 — so 0 and 1 are screen-left of x=260, 2 and 3 screen-right.

Legs (0-5 in paint order) and arms are drawn BEFORE the body silhouette 9, so all limbs sit behind it. That is why the legs are the dark shade and the arms a lighter tint — they are meant to read behind the main mass.

BODY oddities worth knowing: 6 and 7 are the two antenna stalks (they use #FF86C0, the literal middle stop of the body gradient, so this is the truest flat "main" value); 30 and 32 are their balls and 31/33 the white shines on them — note the balls are DELIBERATELY different colours, yellow left and green right, so they are not a mirrored pair either. Shape 8 is a crest of three yellow bumps on top of the head between the antennae. Shape 10 (#FFCCE5, rotated -42) is a gloss highlight lying along the body's upper-left shoulder edge — easy to mistake for part of arm 4 because it begins exactly where that arm meets the body, but it is on the silhouette, so BODY. 11-16 are six lilac spots. 18 and 19 are the blush cheeks.

COLOURS: two gradients. bodyFill is #FFB2D8 -> #FF86C0 -> #F05FA6 and frontFill is #FFF4F9 -> #FFD2E7; those six stop colours live only in <defs> and appear on no shape, so a repaint has to regenerate the stops from the new base rather than swap a fill. The pink family in order of lightness: #FFF4F9/#FFD2E7 (belly) < #FFCCE5 (gloss) < #FFB2D8 (gradient top stop) < #FF9BC9 (arms) < #FF86C0 (base) < #F05FA6 (gradient bottom stop) < #EF6BAF (legs). I mapped #FF9BC9 to "light" because it is a lighter tint of the base, though its job is the arms rather than the belly — if the game only has main/dark/light it can safely take main, it will just lose a little depth between arms and antennae. Fixed colours that must never follow the monster's colour: #0B1B3B outline, #FFFFFF eyeball/teeth/shines, #FF6BA8 cheeks, #A92C63 mouth cavity, #FF6F9E tongue, #46C8E8 iris, #14224A pupil. The three "accent" values (#D6ADFF spots, #FFD84D crest+ball, #86E58F ball) are decoration that could be recoloured per monster or kept as is.

Note that indices 20, 28 and 29 appear under two colour roles because they carry a white fill and a navy stroke; fill="none" (25) and stroke="none" (10-19, 21-24, 31, 33) are not listed as colour values.

Files: scratchpad/flat/5-Bubblegoo.json (generated), scratchpad/check-bubblegoo.cjs and check-bubblegoo.html (my verification render). No project file and no drawing was edited.
